commands: git ls-files | grep -v '^\.\(agents\|claude\|codex\)/' | head -80 && grep -rniE "price|\\$|currency|usd|toFixed" src e2e --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.jsx --include=*.js -l
grep -rnE 'price|\$|toFixed|format' src e2e docs DESIGN.md | grep -v '^src/index.css'; cat src/modules/cart/services/cart.ts src/modules/catalog/data/products.ts

sed -i -E "s/\\\$([0-9]+\.[0-9]{2})/S\/ \1/g" src/modules/catalog/components/ProductList.test.tsx src/modules/cart/components/CartPanel.test.tsx src/modules/cart/services/cart.test.ts e2e/tests/catalog.spec.ts e2e/tests/cart.spec.ts && git diff --stat && pnpm run test src/modules 2>&1 | tail -25

perl -pi -e 's/\$(\d+\.\d{2})/S\/ $1/g' src/modules/catalog/components/ProductList.test.tsx src/modules/cart/components/CartPanel.test.tsx src/modules/cart/services/cart.test.ts e2e/tests/catalog.spec.ts e2e/tests/cart.spec.ts && git diff --stat && pnpm run test 2>&1 | tail -25

perl -pi -e 's/return `\$\$\{value/return `S\/ \${value/' src/modules/cart/services/cart.ts && grep -n 'S/' src/modules/cart/services/cart.ts && pnpm exec vitest related --run src/modules/cart/services/cart.ts 2>&1 | tail -8 && pnpm exec eslint --cache src/modules/cart/services/cart.ts && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental && echo OK
grep -rl "@cart\|@catalog" e2e/tests

E2E_PROD=1 pnpm exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/tests/cart.spec.ts e2e/tests/catalog.spec.ts e2e/tests/cart-empty.spec.ts e2e/tests/catalog-accessibility.spec.ts 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
